stories.title: Flintshire parents urged to apply for September 2027 secondary school places
stories.summary: Parents of children in Year 6 across Flintshire can now apply for a secondary school place for September 2027, with applications open until 31 October for on-time consideration. Children born between 1 September 2015 and 31 August 2016 are eligible to start Year 7 in September 2027. Applications must be made through the online Synergy

stories.title: Police and Natural Resources Wales carry out joint patrol against illegal off-roading in Halkyn
stories.summary: Police and Natural Resources Wales carried out a joint patrol in the Halkyn area this week, targeting illegal off-roading on protected wildlife land. The patrol focused on Sites of Special Scientific Interest, land protected for its wildlife or geology, which have seen repeated illegal off-roading. stories.title: Wales’ PISA scores lowest in UK for third assessment running
stories.summary: Wales recorded the lowest scores of all four UK nations in reading, science and maths in the latest PISA international education rankings, published today. stories.title: New pizza restaurant opens in Shotton with free pizza giveaway
stories.summary: A new pizza restaurant is opening in Shotton this week. Caprinos Pizza will open its fourth Welsh store at 73 Chester Road West on Wednesday, September 9. stories.title: James Morrison and Jack Savoretti announced as first Live at Llangollen Pavilion 2027 headliners
stories.summary: Chart topping British-Italian singer-songwriter Jack Savoretti and You Give Me Something hitmaker James Morrison have been announced as the first headliners for Live at Llangollen Pavilion 2027.
